$comment: Branch protection as code (audit finding CI-017, #3675).
This file is the intended protection for each long-lived branch. The weekly
Branch Protection Drift workflow compares it with the live settings
scripts/internal/apply-branch-protection.sh (dry-run by default). CI never writes it.
status: 'enforced' = drift fails the check; 'proposed' = drift is reported only,
until the maintainer applies it and flips the status to 'enforced'.
Only require a check whose NAME is reported on every PR: a job skipped by its
job-level `if` reports 'skipped' (a pass), but a skipped MATRIX job reports under
its bare name (e.g. 'Run Tests'), so a leg name like 'Run Tests (ubuntu-latest)'
is never reported on a docs-only PR and would block it forever; require the
always-reporting 'PR Gate' aggregate job (#3678) instead. A workflow-level
`paths` filter (Security Audit, Vendored Forks) reports nothing at all.
app_id 15368 is GitHub Actions: a required check is only satisfied by an Actions run.
Optional per-branch 'pending': a complete future protection plus 'when' it must be applied; the check reports it as a pending change without failing (#3677).

main.note: Mirrors the live settings as of 2026-09-27 (no drift on day one). Several contexts predate the slim PR lane (#3325) and are not reported on every PR once it reaches main; 'pending' holds the replacement set (#3677).

pending.when: On the next develop -> main release merge: right after the release PR into main is opened, before it has to go green (the current set names checks the slim lane no longer reports, so that PR could never merge).
pending.note: Same non-matrix set as develop: every context is a code-quality.yml job gated by a job-level `if`, so it reports (success or skipped) on every PR, and 'PR Gate' (#3678) aggregates the Run Tests matrix legs. Dropped: the Run Tests / Build matrix legs (a skipped matrix reports under its bare name; macOS/Windows legs are post-merge only) and Security Audit (workflow-level paths filter; post-merge and daily per #3326). The rest of main's rules are unchanged.

develop.note: PROPOSED - maintainer applies with scripts/internal/apply-branch-protection.sh --branch develop --apply, then flips status to enforced. Every context is a non-matrix job of code-quality.yml gated by a job-level `if`, so it reports (success or skipped) on every PR to develop. 'PR Gate' (#3678) is the always-reporting aggregate that gates the Run Tests matrix legs.
